sources.title: flan-t5-small: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview flan-t5-small is a text-to-text transformer model maintained by google that performs instruction-following tasks across 1000+ diverse NLP jobs. Built on the T5 architecture and fine-tuned on instruction data, this model handles translation, summarization, question answering, reasoning, and classification without task-specific training.
